historic_probe60.note: exclusion is at UTTERANCE granularity (every recording of every historic-probe-60 utterance), not merely the exact recording that receipt happened to read -- see module docstring

run_identity_hash_basis: sha256 over the LF-joined, sorted carrier-prefixed sample ids (f'{carrier}/{id}') -- data.splits.split_identity_hash, the E0 ledger convention an ExecutionPlan/run manifest carries (reproduction.probe_split.VerifiedSplit.identity_hash)
selection_rule: Scenario-stratified over the 18 devel scenarios, as evenly as the eligible pool allows (capacity-aware water-filling apportionment: a stratum smaller than the current fair share is taken WHOLE and the shortfall is redistributed across the remaining strata; the final round splits any remainder one-each in ascending scenario-name order, since every remaining stratum's fair share is numerically identical at that point). Within a scenario, the utterances are drawn via random.Random(f'{seed}:{stage}:{scenario}').sample over the id-sorted eligible pool (mirrors reproduction.sampling.stratified_sample's own per-stratum seeding convention). One recording per selected utterance is resolved via random.Random(f'{seed}:{scenario}:{utterance_id}') over the utterance's id-sorted recordings, mirroring the historic probe-60 receipt's own selection_rule convention. DEV-500 and DEV-100 are drawn the SAME way but over DEV-1000's (respectively DEV-500's) own per-scenario selected utterance lists as the eligible pool, rather than the original devel pool, so each tier is an exact seeded SUBSET of the tier above it.
split_identity_hash_basis: sha256 over the LF-joined, sorted, carrier-prefixed item 'key' strings (reproduction.sampling.split_identity_hash -- the receipt-integrity convention reproduction.probe_split.load_verified_probe_split recomputes fail-closed)
